content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide rep range, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets finish close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank). Moderate loads in the 6-15 rep range are efficient for most lifts, and heavier sets still matter for strength.

Since you're after a 100 kg bench, mix both. Do some heavy low-rep work to practice the lift, and add lighter, higher-rep sets for volume. 💪
